title: Input Robustness — Empty and Acoustic Noise Hallucinations
description: Malformed, empty, or whitespace-only inputs must gracefully ABSTAIN without exceptions or crashes.

mixture_of_thoughts.acoustic_thought: Microphone picked up background cough / silence.
mixture_of_thoughts.formatter_thought: Formatter produces empty string or punctuation noise.
mixture_of_thoughts.decision_thought: Empty tokens immediately yield ABSTAIN with zero errors.
